en.text: “Even today my complaint is rebellious. His hand is heavy in spite of my groaning.

zhSimplified.text: 如今我的哀告还算为悖逆； 我的责罚比我的唉哼还重。

zhTraditional.text: 如今我的哀告還算為悖逆； 我的責罰比我的唉哼還重。

en.text: Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!

zhSimplified.text: 惟愿我能知道在哪里可以寻见 神， 能到他的台前，

zhTraditional.text: 惟願我能知道在哪裏可以尋見上帝， 能到他的臺前，

en.text: I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.

zhSimplified.text: 我就在他面前将我的案件陈明， 满口辩白。

zhTraditional.text: 我就在他面前將我的案件陳明， 滿口辯白。

en.text: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would tell me.

zhSimplified.text: 我必知道他回答我的言语， 明白他向我所说的话。

zhTraditional.text: 我必知道他回答我的言語， 明白他向我所說的話。

en.text: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? No, but he would listen to me.

zhSimplified.text: 他岂用大能与我争辩吗？ 必不这样！他必理会我。

zhTraditional.text: 他豈用大能與我爭辯嗎？ 必不這樣！他必理會我。

en.text: There the upright might reason with him, so I should be delivered forever from my judge.

zhSimplified.text: 在他那里正直人可以与他辩论； 这样，我必永远脱离那审判我的。

zhTraditional.text: 在他那裏正直人可以與他辯論； 這樣，我必永遠脫離那審判我的。

en.text: “If I go east, he is not there. If I go west, I can’t find him.

zhSimplified.text: 只是，我往前行，他不在那里， 往后退，也不能见他。

zhTraditional.text: 只是，我往前行，他不在那裏， 往後退，也不能見他。

en.text: He works to the north, but I can’t see him. He turns south, but I can’t catch a glimpse of him.

zhSimplified.text: 他在左边行事，我却不能看见， 在右边隐藏，我也不能见他。

zhTraditional.text: 他在左邊行事，我卻不能看見， 在右邊隱藏，我也不能見他。

en.text: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I will come out like gold.

zhSimplified.text: 然而他知道我所行的路； 他试炼我之后，我必如精金。

zhTraditional.text: 然而他知道我所行的路； 他試煉我之後，我必如精金。

en.text: My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned away.

zhSimplified.text: 我脚追随他的步履； 我谨守他的道，并不偏离。

zhTraditional.text: 我腳追隨他的步履； 我謹守他的道，並不偏離。

en.text: I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.

zhSimplified.text: 他嘴唇的命令，我未曾背弃； 我看重他口中的言语，过于我需用的饮食。

zhTraditional.text: 他嘴唇的命令，我未曾背棄； 我看重他口中的言語，過於我需用的飲食。

en.text: But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does.

zhSimplified.text: 只是他心志已定，谁能使他转意呢？ 他心里所愿的，就行出来。

zhTraditional.text: 只是他心志已定，誰能使他轉意呢？ 他心裏所願的，就行出來。

en.text: For he performs that which is appointed for me. Many such things are with him.

zhSimplified.text: 他向我所定的，就必做成； 这类的事他还有许多。

zhTraditional.text: 他向我所定的，就必做成； 這類的事他還有許多。

en.text: Therefore I am terrified at his presence. When I consider, I am afraid of him.

zhSimplified.text: 所以我在他面前惊惶； 我思念这事便惧怕他。

zhTraditional.text: 所以我在他面前驚惶； 我思念這事便懼怕他。

en.text: For God has made my heart faint. The Almighty has terrified me.

zhSimplified.text: 神使我丧胆； 全能者使我惊惶。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝使我喪膽； 全能者使我驚惶。

en.text: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.

zhSimplified.text: 我的恐惧不是因为黑暗， 也不是因为幽暗蒙蔽我的脸。

zhTraditional.text: 我的恐懼不是因為黑暗， 也不是因為幽暗蒙蔽我的臉。
